name: Elephant Status manipulable sweep pricing
summary: Permissionless sweep() withdrew BUSD from the Treasury and bought ELEPHANT through BUSD/WBNB/ELEPHANT PancakeSwap pools with zero minimum output, sized from live reserves. The attacker flash-borrowed BUSD, skewed the BUSD/WBNB pair, triggered the buyback into the skewed price, reversed the trade and kept the spread.
notes: Loss is the Treasury's gross BUSD outflow into the two manipulated buybacks (rule 14); the ELEPHANT they bought for the protocol's ELEPHANT Treasury 0xaf0980a0 is not subtracted. The attacker's own net was 114,393.96 BUSD in the anchor.
Of all 6,024 Sweep events from deployment to the last one, only the anchor and 0x092aaf2b contain swaps beyond the buyback's own two hops; every other sweep is a plain keeper or user call.
The Treasury whitelisted the sweep contract minutes after its deployment; that is a new holder of an unchanged withdraw role (rule 10), not a reset.
